# R1 Requirements Quality Checklist: R1 Engine and CLI

**Purpose**: Author-facing requirements-quality review of the full R1 slice (protocol, CLI, math goldens, saved profiles) before `/speckit.tasks`
**Created**: 2026-09-05
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all four preset ids and ui_scale values specified as a closed set? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the looks-like formula (`snap8`, aspect preserve, 2× canvas, scale 2.00) fully specified, including how `snap8` rounds? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Plan research.md]
- [ ] CHK003 Are Fixture A golden looks-like/canvas pairs specified for every preset? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK004 Is Fixture B (1920×1080 perfect) specified as a math acceptance case? [Completeness, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK005 Are `--list`, `--apply`, `--revert`, and `--apply-saved` all specified as R1 CLI commands with no GUI? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006–FR-008, FR-015]
- [ ] CHK006 Is `--output <connector>` specified for both `--apply` and `--revert`, including omit-ok vs required? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK007 Are saved-profile fields (preset, canvas, hz, originalScale) and the connector-name key specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the two-step register-then-reload-then-switch sequence specified, including the ban on pre-register ids? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK009 Is compositor-reject behavior specified separately for register failure vs switch failure? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK010 Is “custom sizes unsupported” specified as a hard abort with a user-visible error? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK011 Is “native” unambiguously the preferred panel size, not the current canvas, including when already at 2×? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, US1 scenario 5]
- [ ] CHK012 Is matching an existing custom size defined as pixel size plus rounded refresh, not exact float equality? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK013 Is “full intended custom-size list (replace semantics)” specific enough to forbid sending only the new size? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK014 Is originalScale write-once (first successful apply) distinguished from scale-before-this-attempt used on failed switch? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, FR-011, Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK015 Is `--apply-saved` “use mode+hz first, recompute from preset only if missing” explicit? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK016 Are CLI exit codes 0–4 mapped to distinct, non-overlapping conditions? [Clarity, contracts/cli.md]
- [ ] CHK017 Is Hz selection (60 if canvas_w ≥ 2×native_w, else cap 120) and the ban on Hz retry quantified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK018 Do revert rules agree that preferred mode is restored, originalScale is restored, and preset/canvas/hz stay saved? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, US3 scenario 4, Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK019 Do Spec FR-016, Edge Cases, and contracts/cli.md agree on `--output` when 0, 1, or many outputs are connected? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK020 Does “no display-doctor at runtime” in Spec §FR-013 agree with constitution III and plan constraints? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK021 Does discovery “revert restores scale from before apply” still agree with clarify “originalScale from first success only”? [Consistency, Clarifications vs docs/discovery-r1.md]
- [ ] CHK022 Do Fixture A goldens, US1 acceptance, and SC-001/SC-002 use the same pixel pairs? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, SC-001]
- [ ] CHK023 Is scale 2.00 on apply consistent across FR-004, FR-010, and the ban on fractional scale? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK024 Can Fixture A `--apply perfect` → looks like 2048×1152 / canvas 4096×2304 / scale 2.00 be checked without extra interpretation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK025 Is “session remains on preferred mode after 100% of failed-switch trials” measurable as written? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK026 Are `--list` required columns (connector name, capability, native/current, scale, four preset rows) complete enough to accept or reject a sample? [Measurability, Spec §FR-006, contracts/cli.md]
- [ ] CHK027 Is “nothing to apply” for empty `--apply-saved` defined as success (exit 0) rather than an error? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §US4 scenario 3, contracts/cli.md]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK028 Are primary flows specified for list, apply, revert, and apply-saved independently? [Coverage, Spec §US1–US4]
- [ ] CHK029 Are alternate flows specified for reuse of an existing custom size vs register-then-switch? [Coverage, Spec §US1 scenarios 3–4]
- [ ] CHK030 Are exception flows specified for missing connector, incapable output, and multi-output without `--output`? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-016]
- [ ] CHK031 Are recovery flows specified for failed switch (preferred mode + prior scale) distinct from user `--revert`? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011 vs FR-007]
- [ ] CHK032 Is `--apply-saved` skip of disconnected connectors specified without failing other connectors? [Coverage, Spec §US4 scenario 2]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK033 Is behavior defined when `--output` is passed but does not match the only connected output? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-016, contracts/cli.md]
- [ ] CHK034 Is behavior defined when `--output` is passed to `--list` or `--apply-saved`? [Edge Case, contracts/cli.md]
- [ ] CHK035 Are unknown/invalid preset ids specified (error vs ignore)? [Gap, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK036 Is profiles.json unknown `version` or missing `outputs` specified? [Edge Case, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK037 Are X11, virtual screens, EDID rewrite, tray, slider, and sleep/resume explicitly out of scope rather than omitted? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK038 Is “apply completes in under 5 seconds” present as a requirement, and is it in the spec or only the plan? [Clarity, Plan Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK039 Are GPL-3.0-or-later / SPDX / no-telemetry requirements in the feature spec itself, or only constitution/assumptions? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK040 Is Plasma 6.6+ Wayland (and not later `add_cvt` APIs) stated as a binding R1 constraint? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, Assumptions]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK041 Is the libkscreen-default / doctor-debug-only assumption documented for implementers of this slice? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK042 Is “Fake compositor backend is not used for CustomModes tests” documented as a test-design assumption? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK043 Is `--apply-saved` immediate (no login delay) documented so R3 autostart is not silently in R1? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK044 Are live DP-3 verification steps treated as an author gate rather than unspecified CI? [Dependency, quickstart.md]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK045 Is `snap8` defined in the spec, or only in research.md, and can Fixture A `large` (1440×810) be derived from the spec alone? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK046 Does FR-005’s 60-vs-120 heuristic conflict with Fixture A leftover modes at 4096@~60 and 5120@~120 without saying which Hz is accepted? [Conflict, Spec §FR-005, discovery-r1.md]
- [ ] CHK047 Is concurrent second `kscaling` apply while another apply is in flight specified or explicitly out of scope? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK048 After a successful `--revert`, is originalScale kept for the next revert, and is that stated in the spec (not only implied)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007, FR-009]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`
- Author should resolve CHK035, CHK045–CHK048 in the spec if they fail before `/speckit.tasks`
